scope: Cloud ROS 2 Humble software regression; synthetic planner and vehicle; no physical flight

planning_wait_policy.action: Hold the leg start until a verified trajectory arrives or the operator stops

assertions: Waiting beyond 8, 30, 105 and 1000 seconds does not itself fail the complete mission or change the held target.
Tracking error and disarming still fail while waiting.
Completed planning waits remain excluded from execution time; excessive execution time is still checked.
A nine-second initial planner delay completed all eight mission stages and confirmed virtual landing/disarming.
A failed run retains confirmed real-SUPER participation without changing FAIL into SUCCESS.
